title: Deals News | Acquisition of ILLIG Group - Orlando Capital GmbH
content: **Orlando Capital V successfully completes acquisition of ILLIG Group**. * ILLIG is a leading global manufacturer of innovative thermoforming and packaging machines, particularly for the food industry. * Complex transaction from insolvency proceedings by Orlando Capital V secures continuation of business operations and strategic transformation of the company. **Munich / Heilbronn, August 1, 2024** - Following the successful signing of the purchase agreement at the beginning of July, Orlando Capital V has completed the takeover of the business operations of ILLIG Maschinenbau GmbH & Co. KG, a leading global manufacturer of innovative and sustainable thermoforming and packaging machines. The transaction marks the third platform acquisition for Orlando Capital V in 2024. The acquisition that has now been completed, the injection of significant financial resources by Orlando Capital V and a significant reduction and flexibilization of the cost base will enable the company to strategically realign itself and concentrate on its strengths in technology leadership and customer focus.
